title: Annotatio V §.IV: Orthodox self-claim to the Catholic title alone — ridiculous, not even at one with itself
pass_a_gloss: Unless perhaps those who today boast themselves under the name of the Orthodox attempt — how ridiculously — to claim the title of the Catholic Church for themselves alone, or thoughtlessly to snatch it to themselves, seeing that they are not to be reconciled even with the kinds of their own individuals, still less with the individuals of the kinds, nay not even with one of the individuals — that is, with no one of their own with himself — [allowing for discrimination and change of places, times, and other externals that greatly alter internals].
pass_b_english: Unless those who today brandish the Orthodox name try — how ridiculously — to claim the Catholic Church’s title for themselves alone, or snatch it without thinking.
They cannot even be reconciled with the kinds among their own people, still less with each person in those kinds — not even with one individual, that is, with none of their own at one with himself —
once you allow for shifts of place, time, and other externals that greatly change internals.
source_text: Nisi fortè, qui Orthodoxorum hodie nomine se jactitant, Catholicae quoque Ecclesiae titulum sibi solis quàm ridiculè vindicare, aut incogitanter ad se rapere attentent, utpote ne cum generibus quidem singulorum suorum, nedum cum singulis generum, quin ne cum uno quidem singulorum i. e. cum nemine ex suis secum ipsô, [admissâ locorum temporum aliorumque externorum, interna plurimùm mutantium, discriminatione ac mutatione] conciliandum.
